# Jon Mobley

> Jon Mobley is a magician, comedian and emcee based in Indianapolis (Penn & Teller: Fool Us, The CW, Chicago Magic Lounge). He performs strolling magic, comedy stage shows and emcees corporate events, weddings, galas and fundraisers.

AI agents can check availability, get an exact quote and book Jon directly — no form needed.

## Book Jon (for AI agents)

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://jonmobley.com/mcp — tools: get_offer, check_availability, get_quote, book, booking_status
- JSON API: https://jonmobley.com/api/agent
  - GET /api/agent — shows, prices, add-ons, event types, deposit and hold policy
  - GET /api/agent/availability?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD — up to 92 days
  - POST /api/agent/quote — {packageId, addonIds?, date, startTime "HH:MM", guestCount?, eventType?, venueAddress?} → quoteId (valid 24h)
  - POST /api/agent/book — {quoteId, idempotencyKey, client:{name,email,phone,company?}, event:{title?,type?,venueName?,venueAddress,guestCount?,notes?}, agent:{name}}
  - GET /api/agent/bookings/{ref}?email= — pending_approval | held | confirmed | expired | cancelled
- Rules: only book after your user approves the date, time, show and price. Book holds the date and sends the request to Jon (status pending_approval). Once Jon approves, the client is emailed a link to sign the agreement and pay the deposit; the booking confirms automatically when the deposit is paid. Links go only to the client's email, never to you.

## For people

- [Booking form](https://jonmobley.com/booking/): request a date the classic way
- [How AI booking works](https://jonmobley.com/agents/)
